# Portfolio Projects

Each project listed below links to a dedicated page with an overview, methodology, and the full report.

::: {.project-cards .project-cards-stacked}
::: project-card
<span class="project-tag">GIS &amp; Dashboards</span>

<h2><a href="projects/ada-parc.html">ADA‑PARC Project</a></h2>

<p>A descriptive analysis of quality‑of‑life disparities between disabled and non‑disabled populations across U.S. geographies, paired with an interactive Shiny website and scorecard dashboards built natively in R and Quarto.</p>
:::

::: project-card
<span class="project-tag">Staggered DiD</span>

<h2><a href="projects/medicaid-expansion.html">Medicaid Expansion & Health Coverage</a></h2>

<p>A staggered difference-in-differences analysis using the Callaway-Sant'Anna estimator to estimate the causal effect of ACA Medicaid expansion on uninsured rates and cost-related care avoidance across U.S. states.</p>
:::

::: project-card
<span class="project-tag">RD Design</span>

<h2><a href="projects/wic.html">WIC Program Evaluation</a></h2>

<p>A regression discontinuity design evaluation using synthetic data to estimate the causal impact of WIC on infant birth‑weight outcomes.</p>
:::
:::
